description: Initial tranche 7 baseline: browser ESM, es2020, minified, gzip level 9; 10% headroom rounded up to 100 bytes. Update only after reviewing bundle changes. Optional-reader rows added in the structured-method/docs follow-up; existing limits retained. Lazy scenarios sum emitted chunk sizes (gzip per file), with 10% deferred headroom rounded to 100 bytes; each initial static graph retains the existing Mercator limit. TypeScript default wrapper baseline added September 30, 2026 with the same headroom; existing limits retained. Automatic LazyProjection catalogue adds a separate initial/deferred budget while existing bundle limits remain unchanged. Tranche 9 compiled pipeline constants measure 17,720 gzip bytes in the rotated initial graph on Node 24.14.0; its gzip allowance increases by 100 bytes to 17,800. All other limits stay unchanged. Tranche 10 shares the optional fused batch adapter between eligible Mercator/UTM/conic plugins. Reviewed lazy initial graphs on Node 24.14.0: UTM 48,390/18,137, WKT 48,258/17,503, rotated 48,316/18,073 minified/gzip bytes; per-scenario limits rounded up to 100 bytes. Static bundle, catalogue and deferred limits remain unchanged. Tranche 12A adds the explicit vertical-height stage (+1154 minified / +317 gzip bytes for core on Node 24.14.0). Increased only exceeded limits, rounded up to 100 bytes with 100 bytes rounding headroom. Optional GTX baseline measured separately; its initial allowance is 10%. Deferred limits are unchanged.
